Send the late reports of one month lost

report_recover.Rd

Each report that left is written in the ledger of its month, as if it had left on time, with the date of the run and the two tables empty: what it named is not what the month after reads back. A ledger that cannot be written stops the month, as in the month the run covers, and what it did not try counts as failed.

Usage

report_recover(batch, mailer, complete, copy_to, dir, at)

Arguments

batch

What provisioning_report() composed for one lost month: mese, ledger, pendenti (who has not received it) and rapporti (their messages, by name).

mailer, copy_to

As in provisioning_report(); IT is in copy.

complete

Whether the run read whole and the ledger of the month it covers read too. Without it nothing leaves, the reports count as failed, and the late ones are tried again on the next run.

dir

The job's state directory.

at

When the run read, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M" in Rome.

Value

A list with rapporti, a data frame of mese, destinatario and esito (mandato, fallito or non_mandato), and errors.
